title: Minimal metrics and interior injectivity for nef adjoints
main_claim: (Thm 1.1) For a projective klt pair (H,Theta) with nef Q-Cartier K_H+Theta, on any log resolution every minimal-singularity semipositive metric on pi^*(K_H+Theta) has zero Lelong numbers everywhere. (Thm 1.2) On smooth projective V, with SNC effective 0<=C_0<=C_2 and L-C_0, L-C_2 carrying zero-Lelong semipositive metrics, H^1(K_V+L-floor(C_1)) -> H^1(K_V+L-floor(C_0)) is injective for C_1 an interior convex combination. Corollary: klt fourfolds with nef adjoint and chi(O_X)!=0 are abundant.
coverage: Read all four sections in full. Thm 1.1, checked step by step: global generation of mN+A via klt Kawamata-Viehweg vanishing plus Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity; existence of the L^{2/m}-extremal sections; compactness (Guedj-Zeriahi plus the normalization e^{M_m}J_m=1); eps_m->0 from minimality and dominated convergence; the localization lemma (g=phi+a/m-tau_m is psh on an affine U, the curvature of S+f(g) dominates f''(g) i dg ^ dbar g, the inverse-curvature bound |chi'|^2 e^{-f}/f'' does not depend on m, and the regularization/weak-limit passage is valid); f<=d max(0,t)+C_f; the identity for G; L^2 extension away from B^-, then descent to H plus Hartogs on the normal base; nonintegrability of e^{-c phi-b} on a cone, which forces w(p)=s(p); the Holder identity (G-a-mb)/(m-1)=(1-eta)(tau-a/m-b)+eta(max-b), re-derived by hand, giving Q(w)^m<=C' eps_m (1+I)^d. Also checked that every density/weight is consistent with N=K_V+B. Thm 1.2, checked: Demailly regularization with Dini on the attenuation functions; log-sum weights with Phi_2<=Phi_0 (so multiplication by s is a contraction); the curvature comparison with factor (1-lambda)^{-1}; the complete Poincare-type metric with bounded potentials (f_0' and f_0'' re-derived); the uniform primitive bound through local L^2 solutions and an open-mapping splitting on a fixed cover; the Bochner estimates (D'* is independent of the line metric, so it commutes with s); and the weak limit in a fixed Hilbert space with a weakly continuous class map. Not verified: the cited Lazic-Peternell Cor D and Gongyo-Matsumura Cor 5.3 (no offline access).

issues.description: The fourfold abundance corollary rests entirely on two cited results, Lazic-Peternell 2020 Cor D (nonvanishing from generalized-algebraic-singularity metrics plus chi!=0) and Gongyo-Matsumura 2017 Cor 5.3. The exact hypotheses of those results (e.g. Q-factoriality, the form of the metric condition, the dimension-3 inputs) could not be checked offline against the paraphrased statements in the paper.
issues.evidence: Thm mm:thm:lp-fourfold and mm:thm:gm-fourfold are restated without proof; the paper asserts 'Neither of these fourfold results requires X to be Q-factorial or non-uniruled'.

issues.description: Not a located gap. The theorem answers Gongyo-Matsumura Question 5.6 in the projective klt case with a short extremal-section argument. Every step I re-derived holds, but given how strong the claim is, an expert check of the localization/extremality mechanism is still advisable. Sibling papers in family 034 (Fourfold-nonvanishing, rank 272) put their full weight on this theorem.
issues.evidence: All steps re-derived without finding an error; the argument does not appear to over-prove (e.g. the non-adjoint P(F_2) example is excluded because no klt psh weight exists on N-K_V).

sibling_notes: This is the 'OpenAIMetrics' companion that Fourfold-nonvanishing (rank 272) depends on for zero Lelong numbers of minimal metrics and for interior injectivity. I audited both theorems and found no gap, so that dependency looks sound as far as I can tell. The interior-injectivity proof does not use Thm 1.1.
